mapper.select: SELECT c.CHANGE_ID, c.CHANGE_NO, c.CHANGE_TYPE, c.ASSET_ID, c.CHANGE_AMOUNT, c.CHANGE_DATE, c.FROM_DEPT_ID, c.TO_DEPT_ID, c.REASON, c.STATUS, c.REMARK, c.TENANT_ID, c.CREATE_BY, c.CREATE_TIME, c.UPDATE_BY, c.UPDATE_TIME, c.IS_DELETED, d1.ORGNAME AS fromDeptName, d2.ORGNAME AS toDeptName FROM TBL_FIXED_ASSET_CHANGE c LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION d1 ON c.FROM_DEPT_ID = d1.ORGID AND (d1.STATUS IS NULL OR d1.STATUS = 0) LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION d2 ON c.TO_DEPT_ID = d2.ORGID AND (d2.STATUS IS NULL OR d2.STATUS = 0) WHERE c.ASSET_ID = #{assetId} AND c.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY c.CHANGE_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_FIXED_ASSET_CHANGE SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATE_BY = #{updateBy}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE CHANGE_ID = #{changeId}
